text.detail-full-desc:
Perché scegliere quando puoi avere tutto? Questo itinerario è la fusione perfetta tra relax e avventura.

Abbiamo creato un flusso logico che ti permette di esplorare Sharm da ogni angolazione: navigherai verso l'Isola Bianca, farai snorkeling dalla spiaggia a Ras Mohammed, cavalcherai le dune del deserto e viaggerai fino al Blue Hole di Dahab.

Ogni giornata è bilanciata per non stancarti, con trasferimenti privati e l'assistenza continua di Fabio.

text.detail-important: L'ordine delle escursioni può essere modificato in base alle condizioni meteo o alle tue preferenze. Si consiglia di portare passaporto, crema solare e scarpe comode.
text.detail-includes: Tutti i trasferimenti privati (Aeroporto & Escursioni)Biglietti d'ingresso ai Parchi NazionaliPranzo sullo Yacht e a DahabCena Beduina nel desertoAttrezzatura snorkeling base (su richiesta)Assistenza prioritaria Fabio via WhatsApp
text.detail-program: GIORNO 1Arrivo & City Tour (Benvenuti a Sharm)Transfer privato in hotel e sistemazione. In serata, 'Fabio City Tour': visita guidata alla Moschea Al Sahaba, shopping nell'Old Market e consigli sui migliori locali per la cena.GIORNO 2Il Grande Blu: Yacht VIP & Isola BiancaGiornata intera in mare. Navigazione di lusso verso il Parco Nazionale di Ras Mohammed e sosta sulla famosa 'Isola Bianca' (le Maldive d'Egitto). Pranzo a bordo incluso.GIORNO 3Natura Selvaggia: Ras Mohammed in BusMezza giornata dedicata alla scoperta di Ras Mohammed via terra. Snorkeling dalla spiaggia (Yolanda Reef), visita alla Porta di Allah, il Lago Magico e le mangrovie. Pomeriggio libero per relax.GIORNO 4Super Safari: I 5 Sensi del SinaiMattinata libera. Nel pomeriggio inizia l'avventura: Quad (moto) nel deserto, cammellata al tramonto, tè beduino e cena tradizionale sotto le stelle con spettacolo.GIORNO 5Dahab Adventure & Blue HoleEscursione in Jeep verso la città hippie di Dahab. Snorkeling nel leggendario Blue Hole, pranzo sul mare e passeggiata nel colorato mercatino locale (Canyon opzionale).GIORNO 6Saluti & Transfer FinaleColazione, check-out e trasferimento privato verso l'aeroporto. text.detail-title: Sharm Confidential: L'Esperienza Totale
text.faq-accordion:
Domande Frequenti & Consigli
    
        
            
                Devo pagare tutto in anticipo online?
                +
            
            
                Assolutamente no. Con Fabio Egypt la fiducia è tutto. Solitamente chiediamo un piccolo acconto per bloccare i posti (specialmente per le barche VIP), e il saldo si fa comodamente al tuo arrivo a Sharm, in contanti o valuta locale. Nessun rischio, zero stress.
            
        
        
            
                Come so l'orario esatto del prelievo?
                +
            
            
                Dimentica l'ansia da attesa! La sera prima di ogni escursione, riceverai un messaggio WhatsApp personale da Fabio con l'orario preciso, il punto d'incontro e i dettagli del transfer. Organizzazione svizzera, cuore egiziano.
            
        
        
            
                Cosa succede se cambio piani o mi ammalo?
                +
            
            
                Siamo umani, non robot! Se hai un imprevisto, scrivici subito su WhatsApp. Faremo del nostro meglio per spostare la tua escursione senza costi extra. ⚠️ Unica eccezione: Per i voli (Cairo/Luxor) dipendiamo dalle compagnie aeree, quindi non possiamo rimborsare i biglietti aerei.
            
        
        
            
                Serve il Visto per le escursioni?
                +
            
            
                Attenzione: Se resti a Sharm (es. Safari, Motorata), il timbro gratuito 'Only Sinai' è sufficiente. Ma se scegli 'Il Grande Blu' (Ras Mohammed via terra) o vai al Cairo/Luxor, devi fare il Visto Egitto (25$) in arrivo. Chiedici se hai dubbi!
            
        
        
            
                Cosa devo mettere in valigia?
                +
            
            
                Parola d'ordine: Comodità. Deserto: scarpe chiuse, occhiali e sciarpa. Mare: costume e crema solare. Insider Tip: Porta sempre una felpa leggera, anche d'estate, per l'aria condizionata nei bus o il fresco del deserto la sera.
            
        
        
            
                Meglio Euro o Valuta Locale?
                +
            
            
                Insider Tip: Porta gli Euro per pagare hotel ed escursioni (accettati ovunque). Cambia una piccola somma in Lire Egiziane per le piccole spese: taxi, mance e market. Pagare in valuta locale le piccole cose ti fa risparmiare molto!
            
        
        
            
                Internet e Wi-Fi?
                +
            
            
                Il Wi-Fi degli hotel spesso è lento. Consiglio d'oro: Compra una SIM dati (Vodafone o Etisalat) direttamente in aeroporto all'arrivo. Costa poco e avrai internet veloce ovunque.
            
        
        
            
                È sicuro mangiare e bere?
                +
            
            
                Bevi SOLO acqua in bottiglia sigillata (anche per lavarti i denti). Per il cibo, durante le nostre escursioni selezioniamo solo ristoranti certificati con standard igienici europei.

included.text: Ras Mohammed & White Island: L'Esperienza VIP8-9 Ore (Giornata Intera)Vivi i 'Caraibi d'Egitto' a bordo di uno yacht di lusso. Snorkeling, relax e pranzo gourmet nel Parco Nazionale.

Dolphin Show: Emozioni per tutta la Famiglia2.5 Ore (incluso trasferimenti)Un'ora di pura magia. Ammira le acrobazie, i salti e l'intelligenza dei delfini in uno spettacolo che incanterà grandi e piccini.
Notte Magica: Cena di Pesce & Show Orientale5 Ore (Serale)Una serata indimenticabile sotto le stelle. Cena a base di pesce, spettacolo di Tanoura e Danza del Ventre mentre navighi nel golfo di Sharm.
Sea Scope: Il Cinema Sottomarino3 Ore (incluso trasferimenti)Scopri la barriera corallina restando all'asciutto. Un'esperienza in sottomarino panoramico con aria condizionata. Ideale per famiglie.

text.detail-desc: La vacanza perfetta per famiglie. Bambini felici (Delfini e Sottomarino) e genitori rilassati (Yacht VIP e Cena Romantica). Zero stress.
text.detail-excludes: Voli internazionali e assicurazione di viaggioSoggiorno in hotel (possiamo consigliare i migliori family resort)Mance ed extra personaliFoto e video professionali durante le escursioni
text.detail-full-desc:
Sappiamo che viaggiare con i bambini può essere una sfida. Per questo abbiamo creato 'Dolce Vita', un pacchetto pensato per azzerare lo stress dei genitori e massimizzare il divertimento dei più piccoli.

Nessuna sveglia all'alba, nessun trasferimento scomodo. Tutto è organizzato con tempi comodi e sicurezza totale. I bambini scopriranno il mare senza bagnarsi nel sottomarino e rideranno con i delfini, mentre voi vi godrete il sole dello yacht e una cena romantica sul mare.
text.detail-highlights: 4 Esperienze incluse (Yacht, Sottomarino, Delfini, Cena)Ideale per bambini di tutte le età (Sicurezza 100%)Ritmi lenti e comodi (niente partenze all'alba)Trasferimenti privati climatizzati per ogni escursione
text.detail-important: Il pacchetto è flessibile: gli orari possono essere adattati ai ritmi dei vostri bambini. Si consiglia di portare crema solare, cappellini e costumi da bagno per tutte le attività marine.
text.detail-includes: Tutti i trasferimenti privati (Aeroporto e Escursioni)Biglietti d'ingresso (Parco Marino, Spettacolo Delfini)Pranzo a bordo dello Yacht e Cena sulla nave da crocieraAssistenza prioritaria per famiglie (whatsapp 24/7)Attrezzatura snorkeling base per bambini (su richiesta)
text.detail-program: GIORNO 1Benvenuti in EgittoArrivo all'aeroporto di Sharm, accoglienza VIP da parte del team di Fabio e trasferimento privato in hotel. Briefing veloce per spiegare gli orari comodi della settimana.GIORNO 2L’Isola che non c’è (White Island)Una giornata da favola. Navigazione verso la famosa Isola Bianca (lingua di sabbia simile alle Maldive) dove i bambini possono giocare nell'acqua bassa e sicura, mentre i genitori si rilassano sullo yacht. Pranzo incluso.GIORNO 3Alla Ricerca di Nemo (Seascope)Mattinata dedicata alla scoperta dei fondali marini con il Sottomarino Seascope. I bambini potranno vedere pesci colorati e coralli attraverso le vetrate panoramiche senza nemmeno bagnarsi. Pomeriggio libero in piscina.GIORNO 4Delfini & Cena SpettacoloGiornata delle emozioni. Pomeriggio allo spettacolo dei delfini (Dolphin Show) per far ridere i bambini. La sera, gran finale con la Dinner Cruise: cena a buffet su una nave di lusso con musica, Tanoura show e brezza marina.GIORNO 5Saluti & TransferColazione in relax, check-out dall'hotel e trasferimento privato verso l'aeroporto con un piccolo ricordo dell'Amico Fabio.

                +

                Meglio Euro o Valuta Locale?
                +
            
            
                Insider Tip: Porta gli Euro per pagare hotel ed escursioni (accettati ovunque). Cambia una piccola somma in Lire Egiziane per le piccole spese: taxi, mance e market. Pagare in valuta locale le piccole cose ti fa risparmiare molto!
            
        
        
            
                Internet e Wi-Fi?
                +
            
            
                Il Wi-Fi degli hotel spesso è lento. Consiglio d'oro: Compra una SIM dati (Vodafone o Etisalat) direttamente in aeroporto all'arrivo. Costa poco e avrai internet veloce ovunque.
            
        
        
            
                È sicuro mangiare e bere?
                +
            
            
                Bevi SOLO acqua in bottiglia sigillata (anche per lavarti i denti). Per il cibo, durante le nostre escursioni selezioniamo solo ristoranti certificati con standard igienici europei.

included.text: Ras Mohammed & White Island: L'Esperienza VIP8-9 Ore (Giornata Intera)Vivi i 'Caraibi d'Egitto' a bordo di uno yacht di lusso. Snorkeling, relax e pranzo gourmet nel Parco Nazionale.
Dahab Adventure: Blue Hole, Cammelli & Canyon10-11 Ore (Giornata Intera)La vera avventura nel Sinai. Snorkeling nel leggendario Blue Hole, trekking nel Canyon Colorato e cammellata sul mare.

Adrenalina Sky & Sea: Parasailing & Water Toys2-3 Ore (Mattina o Pomeriggio)Vola sul Mar Rosso con il paracadute e sfida le onde con Banana Boat e Tubo. Divertimento puro e adrenalina in totale sicurezza.

text.detail-desc: Vietato ai pigri. Un mix esplosivo di avventura: Jeep Safari, Trekking nel Canyon, Moto nel deserto, Paracadute e la tua prima Immersione.
text.detail-excludes: Voli internazionali e hotelTassa d'ingresso al Blue Hole (pagabile in loco)Bevande extra e manceServizio foto/video GoPro (altamente consigliato)
text.detail-full-desc:
Se la tua idea di vacanza è stare sdraiato al sole, cambia pacchetto. 'Indiana Jones' è disegnato per chi cerca l'emozione forte.

Ti porteremo fuori dai sentieri battuti: scalerai le rocce del Canyon Colorato, ti immergerai nelle profondità del Blue Hole, guiderai moto potenti tra le dune e volerai sul Mar Rosso con il paracadute. Cinque giorni vissuti al massimo, con la sicurezza e l'organizzazione impeccabile di Fabio.
text.detail-highlights: 4 Attività Estreme (Jeep, Dive, Quad, Paracadute)Esplorazione del Canyon Colorato (Esclusiva)Tutto l'equipaggiamento tecnico inclusoGuide esperte in sicurezza e avventura
text.detail-important: Per l'immersione è richiesto un buono stato di salute (niente voli aerei per 24 ore dopo l'immersione). Portare scarpe comode per il canyon e passaporto valido per il check-point di Dahab.
text.detail-includes: Tutti i trasferimenti (Jeep 4x4, Bus, Auto privata)Pranzo beduino a DahabNoleggio Quad/Buggy e attrezzatura completa per l'immersioneIstruttore PADI certificato per l'Intro DiveAssistenza medica di primo soccorso disponibile
text.detail-program: GIORNO 1Arrivo & BriefingAtterraggio a Sharm, transfer privato in hotel e briefing energetico con il team per preparare l'equipaggiamento delle avventure successive.GIORNO 2Sulle tracce di Indiana Jones (Canyon & Blue Hole)La vera avventura. Partenza in Jeep Safari verso il deserto, trekking a piedi tra le rocce psichedeliche del 'Colored Canyon' e snorkeling nel leggendario 'Blue Hole' di Dahab. Pranzo beduino incluso.GIORNO 3Missione Abissi: Intro DiveÈ il momento di respirare sott'acqua. Un istruttore professionista ti guiderà nella tua prima immersione con le bombole (Intro Dive). Scoprirai un mondo alieno e coloratissimo che pochi hanno il coraggio di vedere da vicino.GIORNO 4Speed Day: Moto & Water SportsGiornata dedicata alla velocità. Mattina: Water Sports Mix (volo con paracadute + banana boat). Pomeriggio: Double Quad o Buggy nel deserto aperto per una corsa sfrenata tra le dune al tramonto.GIORNO 5Game Over & SalutiRecupero energie, colazione da campioni, check-out e trasferimento privato verso l'aeroporto con tante storie da raccontare.

text.detail-desc: Scopri l'anima del Cairo: i tesori di Tutankhamon, viste mozzafiato dalla Cittadella e lo shopping magico nel bazar.
text.detail-excludes: Biglietti d'ingresso ai musei e monumentiBevande durante il pranzoMance (a discrezione)
text.detail-full-desc: Un'immersione totale nell'anima della capitale egiziana! Inizieremo perdendoci tra i tesori inestimabili del Museo Egizio, inclusa la leggendaria maschera d'oro del re Tutankhamon. text.faq-accordion:
Domande Frequenti & Consigli
    
        
            
                Devo pagare tutto in anticipo online?
                +
            
            
                Assolutamente no. Con Fabio Egypt la fiducia è tutto. Solitamente chiediamo un piccolo acconto per bloccare i posti (specialmente per le barche VIP), e il saldo si fa comodamente al tuo arrivo a Sharm, in contanti o valuta locale. Nessun rischio, zero stress.
            
        
        
            
                Come so l'orario esatto del prelievo?
                +
            
            
                Dimentica l'ansia da attesa! La sera prima di ogni escursione, riceverai un messaggio WhatsApp personale da Fabio con l'orario preciso, il punto d'incontro e i dettagli del transfer. Organizzazione svizzera, cuore egiziano.
            
        
        
            
                Cosa succede se cambio piani o mi ammalo?
                +
            
            
                Siamo umani, non robot! Se hai un imprevisto, scrivici subito su WhatsApp. Faremo del nostro meglio per spostare la tua escursione senza costi extra. ⚠️ Unica eccezione: Per i voli (Cairo/Luxor) dipendiamo dalle compagnie aeree, quindi non possiamo rimborsare i biglietti aerei.
            
        
        
            
                Serve il Visto per le escursioni?
                +
            
            
                Attenzione: Se resti a Sharm (es. Safari, Motorata), il timbro gratuito 'Only Sinai' è sufficiente. Ma se scegli 'Il Grande Blu' (Ras Mohammed via terra) o vai al Cairo/Luxor, devi fare il Visto Egitto (25$) in arrivo. Chiedici se hai dubbi!
            
        
        
            
                Cosa devo mettere in valigia?
                +
            
            
                Parola d'ordine: Comodità. Deserto: scarpe chiuse, occhiali e sciarpa. Mare: costume e crema solare. Insider Tip: Porta sempre una felpa leggera, anche d'estate, per l'aria condizionata nei bus o il fresco del deserto la sera.
            
        
        
            
                Meglio Euro o Valuta Locale?
                +
            
            
                Insider Tip: Porta gli Euro per pagare hotel ed escursioni (accettati ovunque). Cambia una piccola somma in Lire Egiziane per le piccole spese: taxi, mance e market. Pagare in valuta locale le piccole cose ti fa risparmiare molto!
            
        
        
            
                Internet e Wi-Fi?
                +
            
            
                Il Wi-Fi degli hotel spesso è lento. Consiglio d'oro: Compra una SIM dati (Vodafone o Etisalat) direttamente in aeroporto all'arrivo. Costa poco e avrai internet veloce ovunque.
            
        
        
            
                È sicuro mangiare e bere?
                +
            
            
                Bevi SOLO acqua in bottiglia sigillata (anche per lavarti i denti). Per il cibo, durante le nostre escursioni selezioniamo solo ristoranti certificati con standard igienici europei.

text.detail-desc: Vivi la magia del Nilo di notte. Cena a buffet di prima classe, danza del ventre e spettacolo Tanoura.

text.detail-full-desc: Vivi il Cairo da una prospettiva completamente diversa: scivolando dolcemente sulle acque del leggendario fiume Nilo sotto un cielo stellato. Ti invitiamo a una serata di puro lusso a bordo di una crociera di prima classe. Assapora una deliziosa cena a buffet ricca di specialità locali e internazionali, mentre ti godi un vibrante spettacolo di danza del ventre e l'ipnotica danza tradizionale della Tanoura. Un'esperienza magica, perfetta per coppie e famiglie.

text.detail-desc: Lascia il Cairo per un giorno e scopri l'atmosfera greco-romana di Alessandria, la Perla del Mediterraneo.
text.detail-excludes: Biglietti d'ingresso ai siti e alla BibliotecaBevande al ristoranteMance
text.detail-full-desc: Lasciamo il Cairo per un giorno e viaggiamo verso nord per scoprire la 'Perla del Mediterraneo'. Alessandria d'Egitto, fondata da Alessandro Magno, vanta un'atmosfera greco-romana unica. Esploreremo le misteriose Catacombe di Kom El Shoqafa, ammireremo la maestosa Fortezza di Qaitbay (costruita sulle rovine dell'antico Faro) e visiteremo la moderna e spettacolare Biblioteca Alexandrina. Assaporeremo anche un delizioso pranzo a base di pesce fresco con vista sul mare.
text.detail-highlights: Esplorazione delle misteriose Catacombe di Kom El ShoqafaFoto panoramica alla Fortezza di Qaitbay (ex Faro di Alessandria)Visita alla maestosa e moderna Biblioteca AlexandrinaPranzo a base di pesce fresco sul lungomare
text.detail-important: Il martedì la Biblioteca Alexandrina potrebbe avere orari ridotti o essere chiusa; in tal caso la visita sarà dall'esterno o sostituita con i Giardini di Montazah. Porta il passaporto.
text.detail-includes: Transfer privato A/R Cairo-AlessandriaPranzo a base di pesce (o alternative)Guida esperta parlante italianoAcqua in bottiglia durante il viaggio

text.detail-desc: L'esperienza definitiva. Un viaggio completo di 8 giorni che unisce le Piramidi del Cairo, il nuovo Museo Egizio e una lussuosa Crociera sul Nilo.
text.detail-excludes: Voli internazionali e Visto turisticoBiglietti d'ingresso ai siti (pagabili in loco per flessibilità)Escursioni opzionali (Abu Simbel, Mongolfiera)Bevande sulla crociera e mance
text.detail-full-desc: Perché scegliere quando puoi avere tutto? Il 'Gran Tour Faraonico' è il pacchetto VIP definitivo firmato Fabio Egypt. In 8 giorni scoprirai l'essenza dell'Egitto: inizieremo dal Cairo, ammirando le imponenti Piramidi e i tesori del Grand Egyptian Museum. Poi, un breve volo ti porterà ad Aswan per imbarcarti su una lussuosa nave da crociera 5 stelle. Navigheremo sul Nilo visitando i templi più affascinanti (Philae, Edfu, Kom Ombo) fino ad arrivare a Luxor, la capitale dei Faraoni. Torneremo infine al Cairo per perderci tra le strade mistiche della Cittadella e del Cairo Copto. Un viaggio senza pensieri, curato nei minimi dettagli.
text.detail-highlights: Esplora le Piramidi di Giza e il Grand Egyptian Museum (GEM) al CairoCrociera 5 Stelle sul Nilo (Aswan - Luxor) con pensione completaIncontro con la cultura locale al coloratissimo Villaggio NubianoVisita ai capolavori della Valle dei Re e al Tempio di KarnakTour nel cuore del Cairo Antico e Islamico
text.detail-important: Questo è un tour privato e personalizzabile. Possiamo aggiungere un'estensione sul Mar Rosso (Hurghada o Sharm) se desideri rilassarti in spiaggia alla fine del tour culturale.
text.detail-includes: 3 Notti in Hotel al Cairo (Pernottamento e Colazione)4 Notti in Crociera sul Nilo 5 Stelle (Pensione Completa)Voli interni (Cairo - Aswan / Luxor - Cairo)Tutti i trasferimenti privati in veicoli climatizzatiGuida privata egittologa parlante italianoGita al Villaggio Nubiano
text.detail-program: Giorno 1 & 2Arrivo e Le Meraviglie del CairoGiorno 1: Arrivo al Cairo, accoglienza VIP in aeroporto e trasferimento in hotel. Giorno 2: Giornata dedicata alla Piana di Giza (Piramidi e Sfinge) e visita all'incredibile Grand Egyptian Museum (GEM). Pernottamento al Cairo.Giorno 3Volo per Aswan e Villaggio NubianoVolo mattutino per Aswan. Visita al romantico Tempio di Philae e imbarco sulla Crociera sul Nilo. Nel pomeriggio, giro sul fiume per visitare il vivace Villaggio Nubiano. Pernottamento a bordo.Giorno 4Navigazione e Kom OmboMattina a disposizione (Opzionale: Tour all'alba per i maestosi Templi di Abu Simbel). Navigazione verso nord e visita al Tempio di Sobek a Kom Ombo. Cena e pernottamento a bordo.Giorno 5Tempio di Edfu e Arrivo a LuxorVisita al Tempio di Horus a Edfu. Goditi il relax sul ponte sole mentre la nave attraversa la chiusa di Esna per raggiungere Luxor. Pernottamento a bordo.Giorno 6Luxor: La Capitale dei Faraoni(Opzionale: Volo in Mongolfiera all'alba). Sbarco e visita della West Bank (Valle dei Re, Tempio di Hatshepsut, Colossi di Memnone). Nel pomeriggio, esplorazione di Karnak e Tempio di Luxor. Volo serale di ritorno al Cairo.Giorno 7 & 8Cairo Antico e PartenzaGiorno 7: Tour del Cairo Storico (Cittadella di Saladino, Cairo Copto e le sue chiese antiche). Giorno 8: Colazione in hotel e trasferimento in aeroporto per il volo di rientro. Fine dei nostri servizi VIP.

text.detail-desc: L'esperienza definitiva. Un viaggio completo di 8 giorni che unisce le Piramidi del Cairo, il nuovo Museo Egizio e una lussuosa Crociera sul Nilo.

text.detail-full-desc: Perché scegliere quando puoi avere tutto? Il 'Gran Tour Faraonico' è il pacchetto VIP definitivo firmato Fabio Egypt. In 8 giorni scoprirai l'essenza dell'Egitto: inizieremo dal Cairo, ammirando le imponenti Piramidi e i tesori del Grand Egyptian Museum. Poi, un breve volo ti porterà ad Aswan per imbarcarti su una lussuosa nave da crociera 5 stelle. Navigheremo sul Nilo visitando i templi più affascinanti (Philae, Edfu, Kom Ombo) fino ad arrivare a Luxor, la capitale dei Faraoni. Torneremo infine al Cairo per perderci tra le strade mistiche della Cittadella e del Cairo Copto. Un viaggio senza pensieri, curato nei minimi dettagli.

text.detail-important: Questo è un tour privato e personalizzabile. Possiamo aggiungere un'estensione sul Mar Rosso (Hurghada o Sharm) se desideri rilassarti in spiaggia alla fine del tour culturale.

text.detail-program: Giorno 1 & 2Arrivo e Le Meraviglie del CairoGiorno 1: Arrivo al Cairo, accoglienza VIP in aeroporto e trasferimento in hotel. Pernottamento al Cairo.Giorno 3Volo per Aswan e Villaggio NubianoVolo mattutino per Aswan. Visita al romantico Tempio di Philae e imbarco sulla Crociera sul Nilo. Nel pomeriggio, giro sul fiume per visitare il vivace Villaggio Nubiano. Pernottamento a bordo.Giorno 4Navigazione e Kom OmboMattina a disposizione (Opzionale: Tour all'alba per i maestosi Templi di Abu Simbel). Navigazione verso nord e visita al Tempio di Sobek a Kom Ombo. Cena e pernottamento a bordo.Giorno 5Tempio di Edfu e Arrivo a LuxorVisita al Tempio di Horus a Edfu. Nel pomeriggio, esplorazione di Karnak e Tempio di Luxor. Volo serale di ritorno al Cairo.Giorno 7 & 8Cairo Antico e PartenzaGiorno 7: Tour del Cairo Storico (Cittadella di Saladino, Cairo Copto e le sue chiese antiche). text.faq-accordion:
Domande Frequenti & Consigli
    
        
            
                Devo pagare tutto in anticipo online?
                +
            
            
                Assolutamente no. Con Fabio Egypt la fiducia è tutto. Solitamente chiediamo un piccolo acconto per bloccare i posti (specialmente per le barche VIP), e il saldo si fa comodamente al tuo arrivo a Sharm, in contanti o valuta locale. Nessun rischio, zero stress.
            
        
        
            
                Come so l'orario esatto del prelievo?
                +
            
            
                Dimentica l'ansia da attesa! La sera prima di ogni escursione, riceverai un messaggio WhatsApp personale da Fabio con l'orario preciso, il punto d'incontro e i dettagli del transfer. Organizzazione svizzera, cuore egiziano.
            
        
        
            
                Cosa succede se cambio piani o mi ammalo?
                +
            
            
                Siamo umani, non robot! Se hai un imprevisto, scrivici subito su WhatsApp. Faremo del nostro meglio per spostare la tua escursione senza costi extra. ⚠️ Unica eccezione: Per i voli (Cairo/Luxor) dipendiamo dalle compagnie aeree, quindi non possiamo rimborsare i biglietti aerei.
            
        
        
            
                Serve il Visto per le escursioni?
                +
            
            
                Attenzione: Se resti a Sharm (es. Safari, Motorata), il timbro gratuito 'Only Sinai' è sufficiente. Ma se scegli 'Il Grande Blu' (Ras Mohammed via terra) o vai al Cairo/Luxor, devi fare il Visto Egitto (25$) in arrivo. Chiedici se hai dubbi!
            
        
        
            
                Cosa devo mettere in valigia?
                +
            
            
                Parola d'ordine: Comodità. Deserto: scarpe chiuse, occhiali e sciarpa. Mare: costume e crema solare. Insider Tip: Porta sempre una felpa leggera, anche d'estate, per l'aria condizionata nei bus o il fresco del deserto la sera.
            
        
        
            
                Meglio Euro o Valuta Locale?
                +
            
            
                Insider Tip: Porta gli Euro per pagare hotel ed escursioni (accettati ovunque). Cambia una piccola somma in Lire Egiziane per le piccole spese: taxi, mance e market. Pagare in valuta locale le piccole cose ti fa risparmiare molto!
            
        
        
            
                Internet e Wi-Fi?
                +
            
            
                Il Wi-Fi degli hotel spesso è lento. Consiglio d'oro: Compra una SIM dati (Vodafone o Etisalat) direttamente in aeroporto all'arrivo. Costa poco e avrai internet veloce ovunque.
            
        
        
            
                È sicuro mangiare e bere?
                +
            
            
                Bevi SOLO acqua in bottiglia sigillata (anche per lavarti i denti). Per il cibo, durante le nostre escursioni selezioniamo solo ristoranti certificati con standard igienici europei.

text.detail-full-desc: Imbarcati in un'avventura indimenticabile lungo il fiume più lungo del mondo. Questa crociera di 5 giorni e 4 notti da Luxor ad Aswan è progettata per offrirti il massimo del comfort e della scoperta. text.detail-full-desc: Inizia la tua avventura dalla pittoresca Aswan, la porta d'ingresso dell'Africa. In questo viaggio di 4 giorni e 3 notti, ammirerai la bellezza del Tempio di Philae dedicato alla dea Iside. Risaliremo poi la corrente del fiume Nilo, fermandoci a scoprire i templi unici di Kom Ombo e Edfu, fino a raggiungere la capitale faraonica per eccellenza: Luxor. Qui, ti perderai tra i corridoi segreti della Valle dei Re e l'imponenza del complesso di Karnak. Un concentrato di storia e lusso.

text.detail-important: Un'opzione perfetta per chi ha meno tempo ma non vuole rinunciare all'esperienza autentica della navigazione sul Nilo. Consigliamo di prenotare i voli interni in base agli orari del programma.

text.faq-accordion:
Domande Frequenti & Consigli
    
        
            
                Devo pagare tutto in anticipo online?
                +
            
            
                Assolutamente no. Con Fabio Egypt la fiducia è tutto. Solitamente chiediamo un piccolo acconto per bloccare i posti (specialmente per le barche VIP), e il saldo si fa comodamente al tuo arrivo a Sharm, in contanti o valuta locale. Nessun rischio, zero stress.
            
        
        
            
                Come so l'orario esatto del prelievo?
                +
            
            
                Dimentica l'ansia da attesa! La sera prima di ogni escursione, riceverai un messaggio WhatsApp personale da Fabio con l'orario preciso, il punto d'incontro e i dettagli del transfer. Organizzazione svizzera, cuore egiziano.
            
        
        
            
                Cosa succede se cambio piani o mi ammalo?
                +
            
            
                Siamo umani, non robot! Se hai un imprevisto, scrivici subito su WhatsApp. Faremo del nostro meglio per spostare la tua escursione senza costi extra. ⚠️ Unica eccezione: Per i voli (Cairo/Luxor) dipendiamo dalle compagnie aeree, quindi non possiamo rimborsare i biglietti aerei.
            
        
        
            
                Serve il Visto per le escursioni?
                +
            
            
                Attenzione: Se resti a Sharm (es. Safari, Motorata), il timbro gratuito 'Only Sinai' è sufficiente. Ma se scegli 'Il Grande Blu' (Ras Mohammed via terra) o vai al Cairo/Luxor, devi fare il Visto Egitto (25$) in arrivo. Chiedici se hai dubbi!
            
        
        
            
                Cosa devo mettere in valigia?
                +
            
            
                Parola d'ordine: Comodità. Deserto: scarpe chiuse, occhiali e sciarpa. Mare: costume e crema solare. Insider Tip: Porta sempre una felpa leggera, anche d'estate, per l'aria condizionata nei bus o il fresco del deserto la sera.
            
        
        
            
                Meglio Euro o Valuta Locale?
                +
            
            
                Insider Tip: Porta gli Euro per pagare hotel ed escursioni (accettati ovunque). Cambia una piccola somma in Lire Egiziane per le piccole spese: taxi, mance e market. Pagare in valuta locale le piccole cose ti fa risparmiare molto!
            
        
        
            
                Internet e Wi-Fi?
                +
            
            
                Il Wi-Fi degli hotel spesso è lento. Consiglio d'oro: Compra una SIM dati (Vodafone o Etisalat) direttamente in aeroporto all'arrivo. Costa poco e avrai internet veloce ovunque.
            
        
        
            
                È sicuro mangiare e bere?
                +
            
            
                Bevi SOLO acqua in bottiglia sigillata (anche per lavarti i denti). Per il cibo, durante le nostre escursioni selezioniamo solo ristoranti certificati con standard igienici europei.

Why choose when you can have it all? This itinerary is the perfect fusion of relaxation and adventure.

We created a logical flow that allows you to explore Sharm from every angle: sail to the White Island, snorkel from the beach at Ras Mohammed, ride the desert dunes, and travel to the legendary Blue Hole in Dahab.

Every day is balanced so you don't get tired, with private transfers and continuous assistance from Fabio.

text.faq-accordion:
FAQ & Insider Tips
    
        
            
                Do I have to pay everything online?
                +
            
            
                Absolutely not. Trust is everything. We usually ask for a small deposit to secure spots (especially for VIP boats), and the balance is paid comfortably upon arrival in Sharm, in cash or local currency. No risk, zero stress.
            
        
        
            
                How do I know the exact pickup time?
                +
            
            
                Forget the anxiety! The night before every excursion, you will receive a personal WhatsApp message from Fabio with the exact time, meeting point, and transfer details. Swiss organization, Egyptian heart.
            
        
        
            
                What happens if plans change or I get sick?
                +
            
            
                We are humans, not robots! If something comes up, message us on WhatsApp immediately. We'll do our best to reschedule without extra costs. ⚠️ Exception: For flights (Cairo/Luxor), we depend on airline rules, so flight tickets are non-refundable.
            
        
        
            
                Do I need a Visa for excursions?
                +
            
            
                Crucial detail: If you stay in Sharm (e.g., Safari), the free 'Only Sinai' stamp is enough. But if you choose Ras Mohammed (by land) or go to Cairo/Luxor, you MUST buy the Egypt Visa ($25) upon arrival. Ask us if unsure!
            
        
        
            
                What should I pack?
                +
            
            
                Keyword: Comfort. Desert: closed shoes, sunglasses, scarf. Sea: swimwear, sunscreen. Insider Tip: Always bring a light hoodie, even in summer, for the strong A/C in buses or the desert breeze at night.
            
        
        
            
                Euro or Local Currency?
                +
            
            
                Insider Tip: Bring Euros/Dollars for hotels and tours (accepted everywhere). Exchange a small amount into Egyptian Pounds for small expenses: taxis, tips, and markets. Paying small things in local currency saves you money!
            
        
        
            
                Internet and Wi-Fi?
                +
            
            
                Hotel Wi-Fi is often slow. Golden advice: Buy a Data SIM (Vodafone or Etisalat) directly at the airport upon arrival. It's cheap and gives you fast internet everywhere.
            
        
        
            
                Is food and water safe?
                +
            
            
                Drink ONLY sealed bottled water (even for brushing teeth). For food, during our excursions, we select only certified restaurants with high hygiene standards.

We know traveling with kids can be a challenge. That's why we created 'Dolce Vita', a package designed to eliminate parental stress and maximize fun for the little ones.

No alarm clocks at dawn, no uncomfortable transfers. Everything is organized with comfortable timings and total safety. The kids will discover the sea without getting wet in the submarine and laugh with the dolphins, while you enjoy the sun on the yacht and a romantic dinner on the sea.

We have eliminated the crowds and added privacy. In this package, the desert becomes your private refuge at sunset, and the sea turns into a romantic stage. Fabio will ensure that every moment is perfect, from the toast on the Pirate Ship to the candlelight dinner under the starry sky of Sinai.

No waiting, just relaxation from the very first moment.DAY 2Sails in the Wind: Pirate Boat & White IslandA unique day aboard the 'Pirates' Sailboat'. A luxury sailing vessel, furnished in wood and classic style, taking you to the magical 'Neverland' (White Island). Seafood lunch served on board.DAY 3Private Sunset: Quad & VIP DinnerThe highlight experience. Private guide (just for the two of you) with Quads in the desert during the golden hour of sunset. Followed by not the usual dinner, but a 'VIP Bedouin Dinner' by candlelight in a reserved tent, with mixed grill and total privacy.DAY 4Last Night: Romantic Dinner CruiseFree morning for the beach. text.faq-accordion:
FAQ & Insider Tips
    
        
            
                Do I have to pay everything online?
                +
            
            
                Absolutely not. Trust is everything. We usually ask for a small deposit to secure spots (especially for VIP boats), and the balance is paid comfortably upon arrival in Sharm, in cash or local currency. No risk, zero stress.
            
        
        
            
                How do I know the exact pickup time?
                +
            
            
                Forget the anxiety! The night before every excursion, you will receive a personal WhatsApp message from Fabio with the exact time, meeting point, and transfer details. Swiss organization, Egyptian heart.
            
        
        
            
                What happens if plans change or I get sick?
                +
            
            
                We are humans, not robots! If something comes up, message us on WhatsApp immediately. We'll do our best to reschedule without extra costs. ⚠️ Exception: For flights (Cairo/Luxor), we depend on airline rules, so flight tickets are non-refundable.
            
        
        
            
                Do I need a Visa for excursions?
                +
            
            
                Crucial detail: If you stay in Sharm (e.g., Safari), the free 'Only Sinai' stamp is enough. But if you choose Ras Mohammed (by land) or go to Cairo/Luxor, you MUST buy the Egypt Visa ($25) upon arrival. Ask us if unsure!
            
        
        
            
                What should I pack?
                +
            
            
                Keyword: Comfort. Desert: closed shoes, sunglasses, scarf. Sea: swimwear, sunscreen. Insider Tip: Always bring a light hoodie, even in summer, for the strong A/C in buses or the desert breeze at night.
            
        
        
            
                Euro or Local Currency?
                +
            
            
                Insider Tip: Bring Euros/Dollars for hotels and tours (accepted everywhere). Exchange a small amount into Egyptian Pounds for small expenses: taxis, tips, and markets. Paying small things in local currency saves you money!
            
        
        
            
                Internet and Wi-Fi?
                +
            
            
                Hotel Wi-Fi is often slow. Golden advice: Buy a Data SIM (Vodafone or Etisalat) directly at the airport upon arrival. It's cheap and gives you fast internet everywhere.
            
        
        
            
                Is food and water safe?
                +
            
            
                Drink ONLY sealed bottled water (even for brushing teeth). For food, during our excursions, we select only certified restaurants with high hygiene standards.

text.detail-full-desc:
If your idea of a vacation is lying in the sun, change packages. 'Indiana Jones' is designed for those seeking strong thrills.

We will take you off the beaten path: you will climb the rocks of the Colored Canyon, dive into the depths of the Blue Hole, drive powerful bikes through the dunes, and fly over the Red Sea with a parachute. Five days lived to the max, with Fabio's impeccable safety and organization.

Bedouin lunch included.DAY 3Abyss Mission: Intro DiveIt's time to breathe underwater. A professional instructor will guide you through your first scuba dive (Intro Dive). Morning: Water Sports Mix (Parasailing flight + Banana Boat). Afternoon: Double Quad or Buggy in the open desert for a wild ride through the dunes at sunset.DAY 5Game Over & FarewellsEnergy recovery, champion's breakfast, check-out, and private transfer to the airport with plenty of stories to tell.

text.detail-desc: A VIP journey through time: the iconic Pyramids of Giza, the enigmatic Sphinx, and the world's oldest pyramid at Saqqara.
text.detail-excludes: Entry tickets to archaeological sites (payable on-site)Entry inside the Great Pyramid (optional)Tips (at your discretion)
text.detail-full-desc: Get ready for an unforgettable journey through time. You won't just look at the Pyramids — you'll walk where the pharaohs wrote history. Together we'll discover the grandeur of the Great Pyramid of Khufu, the mystery surrounding the Sphinx, and travel to Saqqara to admire Djoser's Step Pyramid, the oldest stone structure in the world. With Fabio Egypt, you'll experience Ancient Egypt with VIP service, no rush, and a dedicated expert guide.

text.detail-desc: A VIP journey through time: the iconic Pyramids of Giza, the enigmatic Sphinx, and the world's oldest pyramid at Saqqara.
text.detail-excludes: Entry tickets to archaeological sites (payable on-site)Entry inside the Great Pyramid (optional)Tips (at your discretion)
text.detail-full-desc: Get ready for an unforgettable journey through time. You won't just look at the Pyramids — you'll walk where the pharaohs wrote history. Together we'll discover the grandeur of the Great Pyramid of Khufu, the mystery surrounding the Sphinx, and travel to Saqqara to admire Djoser's Step Pyramid, the oldest stone structure in the world. With Fabio Egypt, you'll experience Ancient Egypt with VIP service, no rush, and a dedicated expert guide.

text.faq-accordion:
FAQ & Insider Tips
    
        
            
                Do I have to pay everything online?
                +
            
            
                Absolutely not. Trust is everything. We usually ask for a small deposit to secure spots (especially for VIP boats), and the balance is paid comfortably upon arrival in Sharm, in cash or local currency. No risk, zero stress.
            
        
        
            
                How do I know the exact pickup time?
                +
            
            
                Forget the anxiety! The night before every excursion, you will receive a personal WhatsApp message from Fabio with the exact time, meeting point, and transfer details. Swiss organization, Egyptian heart.
            
        
        
            
                What happens if plans change or I get sick?
                +
            
            
                We are humans, not robots! If something comes up, message us on WhatsApp immediately. We'll do our best to reschedule without extra costs. ⚠️ Exception: For flights (Cairo/Luxor), we depend on airline rules, so flight tickets are non-refundable.
            
        
        
            
                Do I need a Visa for excursions?
                +
            
            
                Crucial detail: If you stay in Sharm (e.g., Safari), the free 'Only Sinai' stamp is enough. But if you choose Ras Mohammed (by land) or go to Cairo/Luxor, you MUST buy the Egypt Visa ($25) upon arrival. Ask us if unsure!
            
        
        
            
                What should I pack?
                +
            
            
                Keyword: Comfort. Desert: closed shoes, sunglasses, scarf. Sea: swimwear, sunscreen. Insider Tip: Always bring a light hoodie, even in summer, for the strong A/C in buses or the desert breeze at night.
            
        
        
            
                Euro or Local Currency?
                +
            
            
                Insider Tip: Bring Euros/Dollars for hotels and tours (accepted everywhere). Exchange a small amount into Egyptian Pounds for small expenses: taxis, tips, and markets. Paying small things in local currency saves you money!
            
        
        
            
                Internet and Wi-Fi?
                +
            
            
                Hotel Wi-Fi is often slow. Golden advice: Buy a Data SIM (Vodafone or Etisalat) directly at the airport upon arrival. It's cheap and gives you fast internet everywhere.
            
        
        
            
                Is food and water safe?
                +
            
            
                Drink ONLY sealed bottled water (even for brushing teeth). For food, during our excursions, we select only certified restaurants with high hygiene standards.

text.detail-desc: Discover the soul of Cairo: Tutankhamun's golden treasures, breathtaking views from the Citadel, and magical shopping in the bazaar.
text.detail-excludes: Entry tickets to museums and monumentsDrinks during lunchTips (at your discretion)
text.detail-full-desc: A total immersion into the soul of the Egyptian capital! We start by exploring the priceless treasures of the Egyptian Museum, including the legendary golden mask of King Tutankhamun. Then we ascend to Saladin's Citadel to admire the majestic Alabaster Mosque and enjoy a breathtaking panoramic view over Cairo. To end on a high note, we dive into the scents, colors, and energy of Khan El Khalili market — the oldest and most fascinating bazaar in the Middle East.
text.detail-highlights: Admire the golden treasures of King TutankhamunExplore Saladin's Citadel and the Alabaster MosqueGet lost in the scents and colors of Khan El KhaliliLunch with a Nile view or in the city
text.detail-important: Dress code: Modest attire for the Mosque visit (shoulders and knees covered for both men and women). Comfortable shoes for the bazaar.
text.detail-includes: Private R/T car/minibus transferLunch at a local restaurantItalian-speaking tourist guideBottled water
text.detail-program: 09:00PickupMeet your private guide and depart from the hotel in an air-conditioned car.09:30Egyptian MuseumGuided tour through the immense collections of ancient artifacts and masterpieces of Ancient Egypt.12:30LunchLunch break at an excellent restaurant to recharge your energy.14:00Saladin's CitadelVisit to the medieval fortress and the wonderful Mosque of Muhammad Ali.15:30Khan El KhaliliStroll through the historic market. Free time for shopping, mint tea, and Turkish coffee.17:00ReturnEnd of tour and comfortable return to the hotel.

text.detail-full-desc: Experience Cairo from a completely different perspective: gliding gently over the waters of the legendary Nile River under a starry sky. We invite you to an evening of pure luxury aboard a first-class cruise. Savor a delicious buffet dinner rich with local and international specialties, while enjoying a vibrant belly dance show and the hypnotic traditional Tanoura dance. A magical experience, perfect for couples and families.

text.detail-desc: A spiritual journey through the oldest districts: walk in the footsteps of the Holy Family and discover historic mosques.
text.detail-excludes: Entry ticketsDrinks at the restaurantTips (at your discretion)
text.detail-full-desc: A spiritual and cultural tour of the city's oldest districts. We explore Coptic Cairo, walking through the sacred sites where the Holy Family took refuge. We visit the evocative 'Hanging Church', built upon the ruins of an ancient Roman fortress, and the Ben Ezra Synagogue. We then continue to Islamic Cairo, strolling among ancient mosques and breathtaking architecture that tells centuries of peaceful coexistence and deep spirituality.
text.detail-highlights: Visit to the Hanging Church (Al-Muallaqa)Exploration of Abu Serga Church (Refuge of the Holy Family)Tour of the Ben Ezra SynagogueEvocative stroll along Al-Muizz Street in Islamic Cairo
text.detail-important: Conservative dress is required out of respect for places of worship. Shoulders and knees must be covered.
text.detail-includes: Private R/T transferLunch at a local restaurantExpert Italian-speaking guideBottled water

text.detail-desc: Action and breathtaking views! Speed through the Giza desert on a Quad and enjoy a camel ride at sunset.
text.detail-excludes: Tips for Bedouin guides
text.detail-full-desc: For those seeking adrenaline with an unparalleled view! Leave the city behind and speed through the Giza desert on a powerful Quad (ATV). We'll ride the sand dunes to reach exclusive panoramic spots, perfect for taking incredible photos. The highlight? text.faq-accordion:
FAQ & Insider Tips
    
        
            
                Do I have to pay everything online?
                +
            
            
                Absolutely not. Trust is everything. We usually ask for a small deposit to secure spots (especially for VIP boats), and the balance is paid comfortably upon arrival in Sharm, in cash or local currency. No risk, zero stress.
            
        
        
            
                How do I know the exact pickup time?
                +
            
            
                Forget the anxiety! The night before every excursion, you will receive a personal WhatsApp message from Fabio with the exact time, meeting point, and transfer details. Swiss organization, Egyptian heart.
            
        
        
            
                What happens if plans change or I get sick?
                +
            
            
                We are humans, not robots! If something comes up, message us on WhatsApp immediately. We'll do our best to reschedule without extra costs. ⚠️ Exception: For flights (Cairo/Luxor), we depend on airline rules, so flight tickets are non-refundable.
            
        
        
            
                Do I need a Visa for excursions?
                +
            
            
                Crucial detail: If you stay in Sharm (e.g., Safari), the free 'Only Sinai' stamp is enough. But if you choose Ras Mohammed (by land) or go to Cairo/Luxor, you MUST buy the Egypt Visa ($25) upon arrival. Ask us if unsure!
            
        
        
            
                What should I pack?
                +
            
            
                Keyword: Comfort. Desert: closed shoes, sunglasses, scarf. Sea: swimwear, sunscreen. Insider Tip: Always bring a light hoodie, even in summer, for the strong A/C in buses or the desert breeze at night.
            
        
        
            
                Euro or Local Currency?
                +
            
            
                Insider Tip: Bring Euros/Dollars for hotels and tours (accepted everywhere). Exchange a small amount into Egyptian Pounds for small expenses: taxis, tips, and markets. Paying small things in local currency saves you money!
            
        
        
            
                Internet and Wi-Fi?
                +
            
            
                Hotel Wi-Fi is often slow. Golden advice: Buy a Data SIM (Vodafone or Etisalat) directly at the airport upon arrival. It's cheap and gives you fast internet everywhere.
            
        
        
            
                Is food and water safe?
                +
            
            
                Drink ONLY sealed bottled water (even for brushing teeth). For food, during our excursions, we select only certified restaurants with high hygiene standards.

text.detail-excludes: Entry tickets to sites and the LibraryDrinks at the restaurantTips
text.detail-full-desc: We leave Cairo for a day and travel north to discover the 'Pearl of the Mediterranean'. Alexandria in Egypt, founded by Alexander the Great, boasts a unique Greco-Roman atmosphere. We explore the mysterious Catacombs of Kom El Shoqafa, admire the majestic Qaitbay Citadel (built on the ruins of the ancient Lighthouse), and visit the modern and spectacular Bibliotheca Alexandrina. We also enjoy a delicious lunch of fresh fish with a sea view.
text.detail-highlights: Exploration of the mysterious Catacombs of Kom El ShoqafaPanoramic photo at the Qaitbay Citadel (former Lighthouse of Alexandria)Visit to the majestic modern Bibliotheca AlexandrinaLunch of fresh fish on the seafront
text.detail-important: On Tuesdays the Bibliotheca Alexandrina may have reduced hours or be closed; in that case the visit will be from outside or replaced with the Montazah Gardens. Bring your passport.
text.detail-includes: Private R/T transfer Cairo–AlexandriaFish lunch (or alternatives)Expert Italian-speaking guideBottled water during the journey
text.detail-program: 07:00Early DepartureHotel pickup in Cairo and scenic journey north (approx. 2.5–3 hours) in an air-conditioned vehicle.10:00CatacombsExploration of the largest Roman cemetery in Egypt, carved into the rock on three levels.11:30Pompey's PillarBrief stop to admire the Roman triumphal column and the ruins of the Serapeum.13:00Fish LunchLunch break at a restaurant overlooking the Mediterranean Sea, enjoying the fresh catch of the day.14:30Qaitbay CitadelVisit to the imposing citadel built exactly where the famous Lighthouse of Alexandria once stood.15:45Bibliotheca AlexandrinaTour of the modern architectural masterpiece that honors the ancient and celebrated library.17:00Return to CairoDeparture from Alexandria to comfortably return to your Cairo hotel in the evening.
text.detail-title: Mediterranean Escape: Full-Day Tour of Alexandria

text.detail-desc: The ultimate experience. A complete 8-day journey combining the Pyramids of Cairo, the new Grand Egyptian Museum, and a luxury Nile Cruise.
text.detail-excludes: International flights and tourist visaEntry tickets to sites (payable on-site for flexibility)Optional excursions (Abu Simbel, Hot Air Balloon)Drinks on the cruise and tips
text.detail-full-desc: Why choose when you can have it all? The 'Grand Pharaonic Tour' is the ultimate VIP package by Fabio Egypt. In 8 days you'll discover the essence of Egypt: we start in Cairo, admiring the imposing Pyramids and the treasures of the Grand Egyptian Museum. Then a short flight takes you to Aswan to board a luxurious 5-star cruise ship. We sail the Nile visiting the most fascinating temples (Philae, Edfu, Kom Ombo) all the way to Luxor, the Pharaohs' capital. We then return to Cairo to get lost in the mystical streets of the Citadel and Coptic Cairo. A worry-free journey, curated down to the smallest detail.
text.detail-highlights: Explore the Pyramids of Giza and the Grand Egyptian Museum (GEM) in Cairo5-Star Nile Cruise (Aswan–Luxor) with full boardEncounter local culture at the colorful Nubian VillageVisit the masterpieces of the Valley of the Kings and Karnak TempleTour the heart of Ancient and Islamic Cairo
text.detail-important: This is a private and customizable tour. We can add a Red Sea extension (Hurghada or Sharm) if you wish to relax on the beach at the end of the cultural tour.
text.detail-includes: 3 Nights in Cairo Hotel (Bed & Breakfast)4 Nights on 5-Star Nile Cruise (Full Board)Internal flights (Cairo–Aswan / Luxor–Cairo)All private transfers in air-conditioned vehiclesPrivate Italian-speaking Egyptologist guideNubian Village excursion
text.detail-program: Day 1 & 2Arrival & The Wonders of CairoDay 1: Arrival in Cairo, VIP airport welcome, and hotel transfer. Day 2: Full day on the Giza Plateau (Pyramids & Sphinx) and visit to the incredible Grand Egyptian Museum (GEM). Overnight in Cairo.Day 3Flight to Aswan & Nubian VillageMorning flight to Aswan. Visit to the romantic Philae Temple and embarkation on the Nile Cruise. In the afternoon, a river excursion to visit the vibrant Nubian Village. Overnight on board.Day 4Navigation & Kom OmboFree morning (Optional: Dawn excursion to the majestic Abu Simbel Temples). Navigation north and visit to the Temple of Sobek at Kom Ombo. Dinner and overnight on board.Day 5Edfu Temple & Arrival in LuxorVisit to the Temple of Horus at Edfu. Enjoy relaxing on the sun deck while the ship crosses the Esna lock to reach Luxor. Overnight on board.Day 6Luxor: Capital of the Pharaohs(Optional: Hot Air Balloon at dawn). Disembarkation and visit to the West Bank (Valley of the Kings, Hatshepsut Temple, Colossi of Memnon). In the afternoon, exploration of Karnak and Luxor Temple. Evening flight back to Cairo.Day 7 & 8Ancient Cairo & DepartureDay 7: Tour of Historic Cairo (Saladin's Citadel, Coptic Cairo and its ancient churches). Day 8: Hotel breakfast and transfer to the airport for the return flight. End of our VIP services.
text.detail-title: The Grand Pharaonic Tour: Cairo & Nile Magic (8 Days)

text.detail-desc: A 5-star, 5-day/4-night journey. Explore the Valley of the Kings, majestic temples, and experience the magic of colors in the Nubian Village.
text.detail-excludes: Internal flights or trainsAlcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks on boardAbu Simbel excursion (Optional)Hot Air Balloon in Luxor (Optional)Tips (at your discretion)
text.detail-full-desc: Embark on an unforgettable adventure along the world's longest river. This 5-day/4-night cruise from Luxor to Aswan is designed to give you the maximum comfort and discovery. You'll walk among the giant columns of Karnak, descend into the pharaohs' tombs in the Valley of the Kings, and sail gently south visiting the temples of Edfu and Kom Ombo. The grand finale? A magical felucca ride to the heart of southern culture: the hospitality and vibrant colors of the Nubian Village in Aswan.
text.detail-highlights: 5-star navigation with full board on boardVisit to the Temples of Karnak and Luxor (East Bank)Exploration of the Valley of the Kings and Hatshepsut TempleExclusive excursion to the colorful Nubian Village in Aswan
text.detail-important: The program may undergo slight timing variations due to navigation or the Esna locks, but all visits are guaranteed. Comfortable clothing and sunscreen are essential.
text.detail-includes: 4-night accommodation in double cabin (5-Star Cruise)Full board (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner)All private transfers in air-conditioned vehiclesExpert Italian-speaking Egyptologist guideAll entry tickets to mentioned sitesNubian Village excursion by motorboat/felucca
text.detail-program: Day 1Embarkation & Luxor TemplesArrival in Luxor, check-in on the 5-star cruise ship. Lunch on board. In the afternoon, visit the immense Karnak Temple and the evocative Luxor Temple lit at night. Dinner and overnight.Day 2West Bank & NavigationMorning: (Optional: Hot Air Balloon at dawn). Visit to the Valley of the Kings, Hatshepsut Temple, and Colossi of Memnon. Start of scenic navigation towards Edfu. Overnight on board.Day 3Edfu, Kom Ombo & RelaxationHorse-drawn carriage (Hantour) to visit the Temple of Horus at Edfu. Navigation to Kom Ombo and visit to the double temple of Sobek and Haroeris. Dinner and navigation to Aswan.Day 4Aswan, Philae & Nubian VillageVisit to the High Dam, the Unfinished Obelisk, and the romantic Philae Temple. In the afternoon, felucca ride and visit to the picturesque Nubian Village for a taste of local culture.Day 5Disembarkation (Abu Simbel Option)Breakfast and disembarkation. (Optional morning excursion to the majestic Abu Simbel Temples). Transfer to the airport or train station for the return.
text.detail-title: Royal Nile Cruise: From Luxor to Aswan

text.detail-full-desc: Embark on an unforgettable adventure along the world's longest river. This 5-day/4-night cruise from Luxor to Aswan is designed to give you the maximum comfort and discovery. You'll walk among the giant columns of Karnak, descend into the pharaohs' tombs in the Valley of the Kings, and sail gently south visiting the temples of Edfu and Kom Ombo. The grand finale? A magical felucca ride to the heart of southern culture: the hospitality and vibrant colors of the Nubian Village in Aswan.
text.detail-highlights: 5-star navigation with full board on boardVisit to the Temples of Karnak and Luxor (East Bank)Exploration of the Valley of the Kings and Hatshepsut TempleExclusive excursion to the colorful Nubian Village in Aswan
text.detail-important: The program may undergo slight timing variations due to navigation or the Esna locks, but all visits are guaranteed. Comfortable clothing and sunscreen are essential.

text.detail-program: Day 1Embarkation & Luxor TemplesArrival in Luxor, check-in on the 5-star cruise ship. Lunch on board. In the afternoon, visit the immense Karnak Temple and the evocative Luxor Temple lit at night. Dinner and overnight.Day 2West Bank & NavigationMorning: (Optional: Hot Air Balloon at dawn). Visit to the Valley of the Kings, Hatshepsut Temple, and Colossi of Memnon. Start of scenic navigation towards Edfu. Overnight on board.Day 3Edfu, Kom Ombo & RelaxationHorse-drawn carriage (Hantour) to visit the Temple of Horus at Edfu. Navigation to Kom Ombo and visit to the double temple of Sobek and Haroeris. Dinner and navigation to Aswan.Day 4Aswan, Philae & Nubian VillageVisit to the High Dam, the Unfinished Obelisk, and the romantic Philae Temple. In the afternoon, felucca ride and visit to the picturesque Nubian Village for a taste of local culture.Day 5Disembarkation (Abu Simbel Option)Breakfast and disembarkation. (Optional morning excursion to the majestic Abu Simbel Temples). Transfer to the airport or train station for the return.

text.faq-accordion:
FAQ & Insider Tips
    
        
            
                Do I have to pay everything online?
                +
            
            
                Absolutely not. Trust is everything. We usually ask for a small deposit to secure spots (especially for VIP boats), and the balance is paid comfortably upon arrival in Sharm, in cash or local currency. No risk, zero stress.
            
        
        
            
                How do I know the exact pickup time?
                +
            
            
                Forget the anxiety! The night before every excursion, you will receive a personal WhatsApp message from Fabio with the exact time, meeting point, and transfer details. Swiss organization, Egyptian heart.
            
        
        
            
                What happens if plans change or I get sick?
                +
            
            
                We are humans, not robots! If something comes up, message us on WhatsApp immediately. We'll do our best to reschedule without extra costs. ⚠️ Exception: For flights (Cairo/Luxor), we depend on airline rules, so flight tickets are non-refundable.
            
        
        
            
                Do I need a Visa for excursions?
                +
            
            
                Crucial detail: If you stay in Sharm (e.g., Safari), the free 'Only Sinai' stamp is enough. But if you choose Ras Mohammed (by land) or go to Cairo/Luxor, you MUST buy the Egypt Visa ($25) upon arrival. Ask us if unsure!
            
        
        
            
                What should I pack?
                +
            
            
                Keyword: Comfort. Desert: closed shoes, sunglasses, scarf. Sea: swimwear, sunscreen. Insider Tip: Always bring a light hoodie, even in summer, for the strong A/C in buses or the desert breeze at night.
            
        
        
            
                Euro or Local Currency?
                +
            
            
                Insider Tip: Bring Euros/Dollars for hotels and tours (accepted everywhere). Exchange a small amount into Egyptian Pounds for small expenses: taxis, tips, and markets. Paying small things in local currency saves you money!
            
        
        
            
                Internet and Wi-Fi?
                +
            
            
                Hotel Wi-Fi is often slow. Golden advice: Buy a Data SIM (Vodafone or Etisalat) directly at the airport upon arrival. It's cheap and gives you fast internet everywhere.
            
        
        
            
                Is food and water safe?
                +
            
            
                Drink ONLY sealed bottled water (even for brushing teeth). For food, during our excursions, we select only certified restaurants with high hygiene standards.

text.detail-full-desc:
Why choose when you can have it all? This itinerary is the perfect fusion of relaxation and adventure.

We created a logical flow that allows you to explore Sharm from every angle: sail to the White Island, snorkel from the beach at Ras Mohammed, ride the desert dunes, and travel to the legendary Blue Hole in Dahab.

Every day is balanced so you don't get tired, with private transfers and continuous assistance from Fabio.

We know traveling with kids can be a challenge. That's why we created 'Dolce Vita', a package designed to eliminate parental stress and maximize fun for the little ones.

No alarm clocks at dawn, no uncomfortable transfers. Everything is organized with comfortable timings and total safety. The kids will discover the sea without getting wet in the submarine and laugh with the dolphins, while you enjoy the sun on the yacht and a romantic dinner on the sea.
text.detail-highlights: 4 Experiences included (Yacht, Submarine, Dolphins, Dinner)Ideal for children of all ages (100% Safe)Slow and comfortable rhythms (no early morning starts)Private air-conditioned transfers for every excursion
text.detail-important: The package is flexible: schedules can be adapted to your children's rhythms. It is recommended to bring sunscreen, hats, and swimsuits for all marine activities.

text.detail-program: DAY 1Welcome to EgyptArrival at Sharm airport, VIP welcome by Fabio's team, and private transfer to the hotel. Quick briefing to explain the week's comfortable schedule.DAY 2Neverland (White Island)A fairytale day. Sailing towards the famous White Island (a sand strip similar to the Maldives) where children can play in safe shallow water, while parents relax on the yacht. Lunch included.DAY 3Finding Nemo (Seascope)Morning dedicated to discovering the seabed with the Seascope Submarine. Children can see colorful fish and corals through panoramic windows without getting wet. Free afternoon by the pool.DAY 4Dolphins & Dinner ShowDay of emotions. Afternoon at the Dolphin Show to make the kids laugh. In the evening, grand finale with the Dinner Cruise: buffet dinner on a luxury ship with music, Tanoura show, and sea breeze.DAY 5Farewell & TransferRelaxed breakfast, check-out from the hotel, and private transfer to the airport with a small souvenir from Friend Fabio.

text.faq-accordion:
FAQ & Insider Tips
    
        
            
                Do I have to pay everything online?
                +
            
            
                Absolutely not. Trust is everything. We usually ask for a small deposit to secure spots (especially for VIP boats), and the balance is paid comfortably upon arrival in Sharm, in cash or local currency. No risk, zero stress.
            
        
        
            
                How do I know the exact pickup time?
                +
            
            
                Forget the anxiety! The night before every excursion, you will receive a personal WhatsApp message from Fabio with the exact time, meeting point, and transfer details. Swiss organization, Egyptian heart.
            
        
        
            
                What happens if plans change or I get sick?
                +
            
            
                We are humans, not robots! If something comes up, message us on WhatsApp immediately. We'll do our best to reschedule without extra costs. ⚠️ Exception: For flights (Cairo/Luxor), we depend on airline rules, so flight tickets are non-refundable.
            
        
        
            
                Do I need a Visa for excursions?
                +
            
            
                Crucial detail: If you stay in Sharm (e.g., Safari), the free 'Only Sinai' stamp is enough. But if you choose Ras Mohammed (by land) or go to Cairo/Luxor, you MUST buy the Egypt Visa ($25) upon arrival. Ask us if unsure!
            
        
        
            
                What should I pack?
                +
            
            
                Keyword: Comfort. Desert: closed shoes, sunglasses, scarf. Sea: swimwear, sunscreen. Insider Tip: Always bring a light hoodie, even in summer, for the strong A/C in buses or the desert breeze at night.
            
        
        
            
                Euro or Local Currency?
                +
            
            
                Insider Tip: Bring Euros/Dollars for hotels and tours (accepted everywhere). Exchange a small amount into Egyptian Pounds for small expenses: taxis, tips, and markets. Paying small things in local currency saves you money!
            
        
        
            
                Internet and Wi-Fi?
                +
            
            
                Hotel Wi-Fi is often slow. Golden advice: Buy a Data SIM (Vodafone or Etisalat) directly at the airport upon arrival. It's cheap and gives you fast internet everywhere.
            
        
        
            
                Is food and water safe?
                +
            
            
                Drink ONLY sealed bottled water (even for brushing teeth). For food, during our excursions, we select only certified restaurants with high hygiene standards.

text.detail-full-desc:
If your idea of a vacation is lying in the sun, change packages. 'Indiana Jones' is designed for those seeking strong thrills.

We will take you off the beaten path: you will climb the rocks of the Colored Canyon, dive into the depths of the Blue Hole, drive powerful bikes through the dunes, and fly over the Red Sea with a parachute. Five days lived to the max, with Fabio's impeccable safety and organization.

text.detail-important: Good health is required for diving (no flights for 24 hours after diving). Bring comfortable shoes for the canyon and a valid passport for the Dahab checkpoint.

Bedouin lunch included.DAY 3Abyss Mission: Intro DiveIt's time to breathe underwater. A professional instructor will guide you through your first scuba dive (Intro Dive). Morning: Water Sports Mix (Parasailing flight + Banana Boat). Afternoon: Double Quad or Buggy in the open desert for a wild ride through the dunes at sunset.DAY 5Game Over & FarewellsEnergy recovery, champion's breakfast, check-out, and private transfer to the airport with plenty of stories to tell.

We stripped away everything else to focus solely on the sea. Every day we'll take you to a different spot: from the crystal-clear waters of White Island to the mysterious shipwrecks of Tiran, passing through the depths of the Blue Hole and the wild nature of Ras Mohammed by land. A total immersion in the blue, with maximum comfort.

Bus trip to the Gate of Allah, swimming in the Magic Lake, and snorkeling from Yolanda Reef beach. Snorkeling in this deep blue abyss, Bedouin lunch by the sea, and a visit to the relaxed town of Dahab.DAY 5Lagoons & Wrecks: Tiran IslandTotal relaxation day on the boat towards Tiran Island. We will see the famous stranded shipwrecks and snorkel in the quietest turquoise lagoons of Sharm.DAY 6Last Dip & FarewellFree morning, check-out, and private transfer to the airport. text.included-trips-subtitle: Each experience in this bundle can be explored in detail below.

included.text: Cairo by Bus: Smart Adventure & Your Choice24 Hours (Daily Marathon)History at a small price. An 'On the Road' trip to the Pyramids. You choose: the charm of the Old Museum or the future of the New GEM.

VIP Romantic Dinner: 1001 Nights4-5 Hours (Private Evening)Sharm's most exclusive experience. A private dinner in the heart of the desert, under a canopy of stars. Strictly for couples and special occasions.

Dolphin Show: Thrills for the Whole Family2.5 Hours (including transfers)An hour of pure magic. Admire the acrobatics, jumps, and intelligence of dolphins in a show that will enchant both adults and children.
Dahab Adventure: Blue Hole, Camels & Canyon10-11 Hours (Full Day)The ultimate Sinai adventure. Snorkel in the legendary Blue Hole, trek through the Colored Canyon, and enjoy a camel ride by the sea.
Ras Mohammed Nature Explorer: The Park by Land5-6 Hours (Half Day)A journey between desert and sea. Discover Allah's Gate, Mangroves, and the legendary Magic Lake in half a day.

text.detail-desc: Paradise for those who live with fins on. 4 Complete marine excursions: Ras Mohammed (Sea & Land), Tiran, and the legendary Blue Hole.
text.detail-excludes: International flights and HotelSnorkeling equipment rental (mask, fins, wetsuit)Tips for the crewProfessional underwater photos
text.detail-full-desc:
Did you choose Sharm for its world-unique coral reef? This is your package.

We stripped away everything else to focus solely on the sea. Every day we'll take you to a different spot: from the crystal-clear waters of White Island to the mysterious shipwrecks of Tiran, passing through the depths of the Blue Hole and the wild nature of Ras Mohammed by land. A total immersion in the blue, with maximum comfort.
text.detail-highlights: 4 Sea Days included (Maximize your holiday)Perfect mix of Luxury Boats and Beach SnorkelingComplete visit to Ras Mohammed (by Sea and Land)All lunches and drinks during excursions included
text.detail-important: Passport is mandatory ('Sinai Only' visa or full visa depending on duration). Bring towels and sunscreen every day. Equipment can be rented on the first day.
text.detail-includes: All transfers (Boat, Bus, Jeep, Private Car)Entrance fees to National Parks (Ras Mohammed/Blue Hole)Buffet or Bedouin lunch + drinks on all excursionsProfessional snorkeling guide in the waterMarine taxes and permits
text.detail-program: DAY 1Arrival & RelaxLanding in Sharm, private transfer to hotel. Free time to settle in and prepare equipment for the week of sea activities.DAY 2The Maldives of Egypt (White Island)Starting strong. VIP Yacht day towards Ras Mohammed with a special stop on the white sand strip appearing in the middle of the sea. Guided snorkeling and lunch on board.DAY 3Ras Mohammed by Land (Nature)Today we discover the National Park from a different perspective. Bus trip to the Gate of Allah, swimming in the Magic Lake, and snorkeling from Yolanda Reef beach. Direct contact with untouched nature.DAY 4The Legend: Blue Hole & DahabJeep trip to the divers' mecca: the Blue Hole. Snorkeling in this deep blue abyss, Bedouin lunch by the sea, and a visit to the relaxed town of Dahab.DAY 5Lagoons & Wrecks: Tiran IslandTotal relaxation day on the boat towards Tiran Island. We will see the famous stranded shipwrecks and snorkel in the quietest turquoise lagoons of Sharm.DAY 6Last Dip & FarewellFree morning, check-out, and private transfer to the airport. Heading home with the perfect tan.

text.faq-accordion:
FAQ & Insider Tips
    
        
            
                Do I have to pay everything online?
                +
            
            
                Absolutely not. Trust is everything. We usually ask for a small deposit to secure spots (especially for VIP boats), and the balance is paid comfortably upon arrival in Sharm, in cash or local currency. No risk, zero stress.
            
        
        
            
                How do I know the exact pickup time?
                +
            
            
                Forget the anxiety! The night before every excursion, you will receive a personal WhatsApp message from Fabio with the exact time, meeting point, and transfer details. Swiss organization, Egyptian heart.
            
        
        
            
                What happens if plans change or I get sick?
                +
            
            
                We are humans, not robots! If something comes up, message us on WhatsApp immediately. We'll do our best to reschedule without extra costs. ⚠️ Exception: For flights (Cairo/Luxor), we depend on airline rules, so flight tickets are non-refundable.
            
        
        
            
                Do I need a Visa for excursions?
                +
            
            
                Crucial detail: If you stay in Sharm (e.g., Safari), the free 'Only Sinai' stamp is enough. But if you choose Ras Mohammed (by land) or go to Cairo/Luxor, you MUST buy the Egypt Visa ($25) upon arrival. Ask us if unsure!
            
        
        
            
                What should I pack?
                +
            
            
                Keyword: Comfort. Desert: closed shoes, sunglasses, scarf. Sea: swimwear, sunscreen. Insider Tip: Always bring a light hoodie, even in summer, for the strong A/C in buses or the desert breeze at night.
            
        
        
            
                Euro or Local Currency?
                +
            
            
                Insider Tip: Bring Euros/Dollars for hotels and tours (accepted everywhere). Exchange a small amount into Egyptian Pounds for small expenses: taxis, tips, and markets. Paying small things in local currency saves you money!
            
        
        
            
                Internet and Wi-Fi?
                +
            
            
                Hotel Wi-Fi is often slow. Golden advice: Buy a Data SIM (Vodafone or Etisalat) directly at the airport upon arrival. It's cheap and gives you fast internet everywhere.
            
        
        
            
                Is food and water safe?
                +
            
            
                Drink ONLY sealed bottled water (even for brushing teeth). For food, during our excursions, we select only certified restaurants with high hygiene standards.

text.detail-desc: A VIP journey through time: the iconic Pyramids of Giza, the enigmatic Sphinx, and the world's oldest pyramid at Saqqara.
text.detail-excludes: Entry tickets to archaeological sites (payable on-site)Entry inside the Great Pyramid (optional)Tips (at your discretion)
text.detail-full-desc: Get ready for an unforgettable journey through time. You won't just look at the Pyramids — you'll walk where the pharaohs wrote history. Together we'll discover the grandeur of the Great Pyramid of Khufu, the mystery surrounding the Sphinx, and travel to Saqqara to admire Djoser's Step Pyramid, the oldest stone structure in the world. With Fabio Egypt, you'll experience Ancient Egypt with VIP service, no rush, and a dedicated expert guide.
text.detail-highlights: Walk across the magical Giza PlateauVisit the majestic Sphinx and the Valley TempleExplore Djoser's Step Pyramid at SaqqaraPrivate Italian-speaking Egyptologist guide
text.detail-important: Bring: Passport, very comfortable walking shoes for the sand, hat, sunscreen, and sunglasses.
text.detail-includes: Private R/T transfer in air-conditioned vehicleLunch at a local restaurant (drinks excluded)Expert Italian-speaking Egyptologist guideBottled water during transfers
text.detail-program: 08:30Hotel PickupOur private air-conditioned transfer will pick you up directly from your Cairo or Giza hotel.09:30Giza Plateau & PyramidsArrival at the Pyramids (Khufu, Khafre & Menkaure). Time for memorable panoramic photos and historical explanations.11:30The Great SphinxVisit to the Valley Temple and a face-to-face encounter with the iconic Sphinx.13:00Traditional LunchStop at a quality local restaurant to savor authentic Egyptian dishes.14:30SaqqaraTransfer to Saqqara to explore Djoser's funerary complex and the first pyramid ever built.16:30ReturnRelaxing drive back to the hotel after a history-packed day.
text.detail-title: Eternal Grandeur: Pyramids of Giza, Sphinx & Saqqara
